result.summary: The page looks mostly intact, but a few horizontal cards are visibly clipped/truncated, which makes the layout feel slightly broken. There are no obvious critical issues.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" row is partially cut off at the edge of the screen, and its title is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal carousel spacing or pagination affordance so partially visible items look intentional, or ensure the card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: The next card in "Popular right now" is cut off at the bottom by the fixed bottom navigation area, making it look clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/scroll inset so list content stays fully visible above the persistent navigation bar.
